description: This file defines a final class 'Header' with static methods for parsing and normalizing HTTP header fields, primarily dealing with string manipulation and array processing related to HTTP headers.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to parse and normalize HTTP header fields.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an array of header values containing ';' separated data into an array of associative arrays representing header key-value pairs. Injects empty string values for keys without associated values.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Converts an array of header values that may contain comma-separated entries into a flattened array of individual header values, trimming whitespace accordingly.
